newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Poongsan sees 18 pct rise in brass output.
newsitem.headline: Poongsan sees 18 pct rise in brass output.

text.p: South Korea's Poongsan Corp said on Thursday its brass production was expected to rise 18 percent to 205,000 tonnes in 1997 from 173,000 tonnes a year ago.
Poongsan is South Korea's largest brass miller.
A company spokesman said the company had set the target for this year's sales at 800 billion won, up from 786.5 billion won in 1996.
The company plans to increase this year's capital investment to 100 billion won from last year's 60 bllion won, he said.
